title: 'Do not disturb' notification briefly visible in panel when going into and out of fullscreen
line: The Do Not Disturb bell no longer flashes in the panel when a window enters or leaves fullscreen.
explanation: Focusing a fullscreen window turns on Do Not Disturb, and any inhibition made the notifications applet active, so the system tray showed its muted bell. While the window animates into fullscreen the panel is still visible, and when leaving fullscreen the panel's old frame (bell included) is shown before the state update arrives, so the bell flashed in both directions. Globals now tracks whether the inhibition comes only from a focused fullscreen window, and in that case the applet stays passive; Do Not Disturb itself (popups, sounds) is unchanged, and manual, scheduled, app or mirrored-screen inhibition still shows the bell.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: don't show in panel when only fullscreen inhibits

Entering or leaving fullscreen briefly showed the Do Not Disturb icon in
the panel, as the window doesn't cover it yet or anymore. Inhibition that
only comes from a focused fullscreen window no longer makes it active.

BUG: 505169
